principle: Production keeps postmarketOS/KDE defaults and only the irreducible board layer. Debug-only policy is never installed or persisted.

board_default_powerdevilrc.upstream_key_semantics: PowerDevilProfileSettings.kcfg defines AutoSuspendAction (UInt, NoAction=0) and AutoSuspendIdleTimeoutSec (Int, seconds). KDE's desktop KCM writes AutoSuspendAction=0 for 'Never'; the Plasma Mobile KCM (kcm_mobile/mobilepower.cpp) writes AutoSuspendIdleTimeoutSec=0. suspendsession.cpp loadAction() returns early when the action is NoAction and only registers the idle timer when m_idleTime != 0s, so 0/0 means never from either UI. Both names and meanings are unchanged between powerdevil 6.6.6 and master.
board_default_powerdevilrc.reason: s2idle on the 7.3.1 kernel takes down both USB/NCM and Wi-Fi, the only remote access paths; both values are what the two KDE power frontends write for Never, and either is overridable by ~/.config/powerdevilrc
board_default_powerdevilrc.critical_battery: left at the upstream default: [BatteryManagement] BatteryCriticalAction is Sleep when the system can suspend, which protects the pack at 5% and is independent of idle auto-suspend
